subject: [PATCH v6 02/12] mm, swap: support zswap and zero-filled swap pages as vswap backends

2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch adds support for zswap and zero-filled swap pages as vswap backends, allowing users to use zswap without a physical backing swapfile. It introduces new logic for reclaim and overcommit, including the addition of mem_cgroup_can_swap() to determine if an anonymous page can be swapped out, and updates the OVERCOMMIT_GUESS heuristic to account for vswap-backed entries. The patch also disables THP swapin for vswap entries and modifies zswap writeback behavior when vswap is enabled.
